Missing item: cobblemon:sacred_ash -> cobblemon:revival_herb. No installed jar or datapack registers a Sacred Ash (Cobblemon 1.8.0 has none), so the entry was rolled and dropped nothing. The owner, 2026-10-08: "Entei's Sacred Ash gets a substitute that exists and suits a revival." Revival Herb (assets/cobblemon/models/item/revival_herb.json in the Cobblemon jar, read 2026-10-08) is a revival item in its own right (it revives a fainted Pokemon at a cost in friendship), as Sacred Ash is the ash that revived the beasts. Chosen over Max Revive, the other candidate, because it cannot become a farm: data/bank.json does not buy it (nor revive or max_revive: base_removed), no counter sells it (data/traders.json stock_policy withhold_items names it), and it is already a crop (data/bank.json afk_rule), so a guaranteed drop gives a player nothing a herb plot does not. Max Revive would be the scarce item: data/markets.json sells it at 2,900, and a pastured Entei or Ho-Oh under Pasture Loot (9 picks an hour, one entry of two: docs/research/DROPS_AUDIT.md section 2.6, relayed, not measured for a legendary) would make about four an hour unattended. Only the id is changed; amount, order and percentages are upstream's, so the herb drops at the rate upstream gave the ash: every defeat.
fixes.dungeon_boss: This table DOES reach the repeatable boss (data/entei_boss.json), on top of the boss's own reward, not instead of it. The boss is a wild Entei (no owner) and Cobblemon rolls an unowned Pokemon's species table when its entity dies (PokemonServerDelegate.doDeathDrops: no owner and doPokemonLoot, nothing checks the cause; docs/research/DROPS_AUDIT.md section 2.2, the step from a battle faint to entity death ASSUMED there). So a defeated boss Entei drops, at its body: its held item first (farm mode holds a Life Orb, catch mode a Sitrus Berry: data/entei_boss.json props), then this table (a Charcoal Stick and a Revival Herb), while cobblers:entei_boss/drops gives one item of six straight to the owner (drops.rule). A caught Entei dies no death and drops nothing. The keeper's `kill` of an unfought or abandoned Entei is a death too and drops the same at an empty slot. None of this is observed: EXP-059.

Ambiguous: the Cobblemon jar and Mega Showdown both ship data/cobblemon/species/generation5/kyurem.json, and which mod's file the loader takes is mod load order. Read both 2026-10-08: Cobblemon's carries a drop table (amount 3, Dragon's Breath 2-3, every defeat); Mega Showdown's carries NO `drops` key at all, so if it wins Kyurem drops nothing. Mega Showdown's file is a rework of the species for its own purposes (it adds `implemented` and `riding`, and changes baseScale, hitbox, forms and behaviour) that leaves drops out rather than setting an empty table, so it states no intent about drops and there is nothing to merge. Chosen: Cobblemon's table, the only one either mod ships. Our species_additions file sets `drops`, which replaces the species table after whichever species file loaded (module docstring), so load order no longer decides Kyurem's drops. Only drops: which mod's baseScale, hitbox, forms, behaviour and riding win is still the loader's, and is not a drop table's to settle. The White and Black forms carry no table of their own in either file, so they follow this one.
